name: bartholomew-mcp-security-gate
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) in-process execution firewall, zero-blast-radius workspace rollback, runaway spend circuit breaker, and cryptographic AIBOM attestation engine for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and custom agent swarms.

tools.name: btp_workspace_snapshot
tools.description: Takes a sub-10ms copy-on-write workspace delta snapshot before an agent executes risky refactors or bash commands.

tools.name: btp_workspace_rollback
tools.description: 1-Click instant micro-rollback restoring workspace files to previous snapshot in <10ms with zero blast radius.

snapshot_id.description: Specific snapshot ID to restore, or omit for most recent

tools.name: btp_runaway_guard
tools.description: Monitors trajectory error loop ping-pongs and cumulative token spend, interdicting runaway loops before exceeding $2.50 hard cap.

tools.name: btp_mint_aibom
tools.description: Mints an Ed25519 signed AI Bill of Materials (AIBOM) Merkle attestation trailer for SOC 2 Type II and EU AI Act compliance on Git commits.

tools.name: btp_scan_workspace
tools.description: Audits workspace for secrets, unconstrained deletion, SQL mutations, and prompt injections, emitting an Ed25519 trust scorecard.

tools.name: btp_protect_tool_call
tools.description: Evaluates proposed tool call arguments in-process (<35us) against destructive execution, SQL mutations, and prompt injections, emitting structured remediation hints if denied.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being executed
